title: HLOOKUP truncates row_index_num, checks index bounds only after a match, and returns #VALUE! below 1 (down to -2^31) or #REF! beyond table rows
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, HLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, row_index_num, [range_lookup]) defaults range_lookup to TRUE (bisection), supports wildcards (* and ?) when range_lookup is FALSE, truncates row_index_num toward zero (1.9 -> 1), checks row_index_num bounds only after finding a matching column (so a miss returns #N/A), and returns #VALUE! for row_index_num < 1 (above -2^31) or #REF! for row_index_num > table rows (or <= -2^31). All 3,360 full-bank HLOOKUP rows match.
basis: Measured in DnaCalc cfunc_m3_6 (lookup_edges rows 280-302) and jnt_lookup rows 38-42 (Excel 16.0.20527.20088); 3,360/3,360 full-bank rows match.
